name: Grant Paige
source: A meek Quality Assurance worker at the same company that Jade works at. He has severe self-esteem issues and constantly feels that he’s not worth much attention. It seems almost like he’s trying to avoid talking about himself or bringing any attention to himself and is more than happy to let Jade overwhelm the conversation. But this makes him an easy target for others to take advantage of.
